_comment: Burst-MLE lifetime analysis, emtk app: AutoForm over MleViewModel (the engine's session). Files and the fit-parameter table are data_table sections; every field has a description.

sections.description: Burst files to fit and the fit model.
sections.title: Burst files

buttons.label: Load example
buttons.description: Replace working inputs with a reproducible real PTU/BUR demo in the settings cache: 16 bursts of 1000 photons, generated lifetime2ns and32ps clock. Press Auto IRF/background separately; saved measurement files are unchanged.

sections.label: Fit model
sections.description: Registered tttrlib lifetime estimator used by the preview and every detector's batch fit. Fit23 measures a single lifetime with anisotropy, Fit24 a bi-exponential decay, and Fit25 selects among four fixed candidate lifetimes. Each model retains its start values and fixed flags.
Available registered estimators and the additional inputs required by models unavailable in this workflow.
The current fit's primary lifetime and score. Fit25 additionally reports the registered winning candidate index (0-based); candidate lifetimes remain input parameters.
The burst (.bur) tables of the analysis, in the order they are fitted. Click a row to select it, Delete removes it. Dropping .bur files, a folder or a .pto container adds them.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The burst table's file name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Folder
columns.tooltip: The folder the table is in.

sections.description: Detector, fit window (in bins of the setup's micro-time binning) and minimum photons per burst.
sections.title: Detector and window

sections.label: Detector
sections.description: The detector (colour) whose decay is shown and fitted. Define detectors in the Detector setup tab.

The detector's G factor and leakages l1, l2 (set in the Detector setup tab) and the rate of its background in kHz: the buffer's, else the strict background selection's (the measurement's stretches at the background level, away from every burst), else the flat + scatter part of the photons outside the bursts; beside it the rate of all photons outside the bursts (mostly molecules below the burst threshold) and how much time the strict selection kept. The status line names what the background is and why.

sections.label: Current file
sections.description: Index of the burst file whose decay is shown (0 is the first).

sections.label: Window start [bin]
sections.description: First micro-time bin of the fit window, in bins of the setup's micro-time binning. Drag the green line or type it; until set, the window is the detector's gate. It may reach past the gate.

sections.label: Window stop [bin]
sections.description: Micro-time bin after the last bin of the fit window. Leave out the noisy tail. Until set, the window is the detector's gate; it may reach past the gate.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: A burst with fewer photons in the fit window is not fitted (its lifetime is left empty).

sections.title: Measured IRF and background
sections.description: Measured IRF files instead of the estimate from the non-burst photons, and buffer files that correct a scatter IRF for its background. The background of the fit is always the photons outside the bursts (the reverse burst selection), whatever the IRF came from.

sections.label: IRF: one for all
sections.description: The IRF files serve every detector; each detector reads its own channels from them. Off: files are set for the selected detector only.
Measured IRF files of the selected detector (their VV and VH histograms are summed and each polarisation normalised to one). Delete removes a file.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The measurement file's name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Folder
columns.tooltip: The folder the file is in.

sections.label: Background: one for all
sections.description: The buffer files serve every detector; each detector reads its own channels from them. Off: files are set for the selected detector only.

Buffer measurements of the selected detector (histograms in counts per second, summed): they correct a scatter (water, Ludox) IRF for its background. The background of the fit is always the photons outside the bursts. Delete removes a file.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The measurement file's name; hover a row for the full path.

columns.title: Folder
columns.tooltip: The folder the file is in.

sections.label: Save VV/VHs
sections.description: Write the VV and VH histogram of every IRF or background file beside it (<file>_<channels>.dat) when it is read.
Where the IRF comes from. Everything else about it is the IRF tool's.
sections.title: IRF from

sections.description: Where the IRF of this detector comes from. Auto is right for a typical run: the reference dye, else the IRF measurement, else the photons outside the bursts, else an estimate from the data. A choice whose measurement is missing is greyed.

sections.title: Fit parameters
sections.description: The selected model's free input parameters, start values, fixed flags and fitted values, and the detector's three time shifts: IRF shift VV and VH (the IRF against the VV and VH data, bins) and Shift VV/VH (the VH decay against the VV decay, whole bins). A shift starts at its calibration on the reference dye (hover its row for where it came from) and is fixed by default; unfixed, the fit refines it within half a bin (one bin for Shift VV/VH). Fit25 lifetimes remain classification candidates; its primary fitted lifetime identifies the winning candidate. Double-click a start value to type. A change refits the current decay.

columns.title: Parameter
columns.tooltip: Parameters declared by the selected tttrlib model. Lifetimes and rotational correlation times are in ns; fractions and anisotropy are dimensionless.

columns.title: Start
columns.tooltip: Starting value of the optimiser (the value itself when the parameter is fixed).

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Hold the parameter at its start value.

columns.title: Result
columns.tooltip: Fitted value of the current decay.

sections.description: Shown when a time shift of this detector was set by hand.

buttons.label: Reset shifts
buttons.description: The detector's time shifts back to their calibration on the reference dye (0 without one), and the decay fitted again.

sections.title: H2MM states
sections.description: Split the fit by the per-photon states of an H2MM run of the same burst folder.

sections.label: Split by H2MM state
sections.description: Fit each burst once more per H2MM state (Tau S0 (G|G) ... beside Tau (G|G)), after a fit of each state's decay pooled over the measurement, whose lifetime also starts the per-burst fits. Needs an H2MM run of this burst folder.

sections.label: State min photons
sections.description: A burst's state with fewer photons in the window is not fitted (its columns stay empty).
The pooled lifetime of each state and detector from the last Fit bursts (also written to Info/state_lifetimes.csv).

sections.title: Fit options
sections.description: How the fit is scored and how far Opt searches.

sections.label: 2I*: P+2S
sections.description: Use the P+2S form of the 2I* statistic.

sections.label: BIFL scatter
sections.description: Treat the scattered light as burst-integrated fluorescence lifetime scatter (soft).

sections.label: Opt iterations
sections.description: Number of fits the Opt button may spend searching the VH shift, sub-bin shifts, IRF window and IRF thresholds for the lowest 2I*.
Burst shown in the result plot.
sections.title: Burst

sections.label: Burst
sections.description: Index of the burst shown in the inspected-burst plot (all bursts of all loaded files).
Fitted lifetime of each burst.
sections.title: Burst lifetimes

columns.label: Series
columns.description: Detection colour (or state and colour in the segment-level analysis).

columns.label: Median tau [ns]
columns.description: Median fitted lifetime of the series.

columns.label: Mean tau [ns]
columns.description: Mean fitted lifetime of the series.
